releaseIntent: Deliver one production-grade, openly reviewable v2.0 candidate under the canonical YIYUAN Accord identity, with fresh behavior evidence and no compatibility alias for the superseded identity.

increment.observedProblem: The public repository display was renamed while the active module, package identifiers, commands, authority files, documentation and observations still carried a superseded technical identity. Staging aliases would preserve ambiguity, and relabeling v1.2 observations would manufacture evidence for a projection they never exercised. The accepted reports also require a clearer product category, explicit human-AI mission versus current human-Agent scope, tighter lifecycle evaluation and a finite path to closeout.
increment.hypothesis: One complete breaking identity migration, a single collaboration reliability domain model, thin runtime-free projections, a generic verifier and fresh current-projection Golden Task observations can restore global consistency without adding a compatibility layer or turning the framework into a runtime, governance platform or universal correctness claim.

historical observations are edited or relabeled as current v2.0 evidence

the broader human-AI mission is presented as already verified by the current human-Agent product surface
the rename adds a runtime, Hook, MCP, App, mandatory user-level Skill or undeclared installation authority
the generic verifier accepts an incomplete identity, stale projection evidence or repository self-authorization
a required host package no longer satisfies its native manifest shape

an unresolved P0 or P1 finding remains when exact local review completes
increment.finiteStopCondition: Stop this increment when one locally committed clean candidate has the canonical v2.0 identity and domain model aligned across the active tree, the live verifier computes every deterministic lane, every required current-projection Golden Task has substantive fresh evidence without hidden failure, all eight repository criteria are satisfied and no known validation defect or task residue remains. Exact local verification and independent review, push, hosted verification, named-human authorization, publication and post-release cleanup follow only through the ordered task-time gates.

closeoutSequence.stopCondition: [canonical-identity-authority-and-projections] Every active local identity, authority, module, projection, command, document and test uses the canonical v2.0 terms; incompatible old observations are absent from the active tree and no alias remains.

[static-conformance-and-adversarial-regressions] The generic verifier computes deterministic conformance directly; complete projection-package checks, release-surface bindings, full regression tests and residue checks pass without a known validation defect. No repository observation may self-attest these results.

[fresh-representative-behavior] Each required Golden Task has one fresh current-projection observation with independent source evidence, predeclared behavior decisions, human-burden metrics, material effects, cleanup disposition and an explicit claim limit; designated authority, evidence, no-op and subtraction guardrails pass, while any admissible failure remains failed and its exact exclusions are aggregated into the public claim ceiling.

[repository-candidate-freeze] All eight repository criteria are satisfied on one clean tree, the release body is time-neutral and reproducible, no known blocker or task residue remains, the increment and work item are retained as completed, and the exact candidate is committed locally for the task-time verification-and-review gate.

orderedGates.condition: One locally committed clean candidate aligns the canonical identity, domain model, authority, verifier, reference projections, documentation, tests and fresh representative evidence; all eight repository criteria are satisfied and no known blocker or task residue remains.

On the unchanged clean local candidate, the active goal carrier directly runs the canonical verifier, both host checks, full product tests, diff, identity, link, workflow and residue checks plus independent specification and standards-security review. An independent human or second observation surface compares the publishable source bundle with the original host or session records, and one non-author colleague completes a clean-state README activation, confirmation and removal walkthrough; the walkthrough is an internal usability sample only. Any P0/P1 blocks the gate. Repository self-report cannot satisfy it, and only after it passes may the same SHA be pushed.

After push, the active goal carrier directly verifies the unchanged clean HEAD on GitHub Actions for Linux, Windows and macOS plus ordinary Codex Cloud; repository self-report and earlier revisions are insufficient.

Only after exact hosted verification, present the unchanged SHA, complete claim ceiling, retained failures and continuing evidence lanes to a named accountable human; the decision must preserve a real veto and is not written into the candidate.
Create the lightweight v2.0 tag and public release only after hosted verification and exact named-human authorization for the unchanged candidate; do not move the tag or attach assets.

The active goal carrier directly verifies the public release, remote and local tag, exact tracked release notes and zero-asset policy; it then removes task-created resources, confirms repository and evaluator residue are absent, and replays local validation.

releaseProcedure.rule: Execute gates strictly in listed order. Failure returns to the smallest affected prior gate; no report, plan, test, commit, push, hosted pass or authorization is promoted into a later effect.

goalModePrompt.objective: 在 product/constitution.json、product/program.json、product/acceptance.json 三份唯一语义权威下，按工业/商业生产级交付标准完成 YIYUAN Accord v2.0 的有限收官；保持开放、Agent 中立、无 Runtime/Hook/MCP/App，广义使命面向人类与 AI 协作，当前可验证范围仅为人类与 Agent 协作。计划、工序、R1-R4/Q1-Q4 验收、目标提示词、证据、投影和公开面必须持续映射。既有工作阶段保持为 canonical-identity-authority-and-projections → static-conformance-and-adversarial-regressions → fresh-representative-behavior → repository-candidate-freeze；GT-07/GT-08 保持失败并收窄主张。候选严格依次经过 repository-candidate → exact-local-verification-and-review → exact-candidate-hosted-verification → exact-human-release-authorization → exact-tagged-public-release → release-verification-and-cleanup。精确本地门必须在不变 clean SHA 上完成全量验证、独立规格与标准安全反审、可发布 source bundle 对原始宿主记录的独立对照，以及一名非作者同事从 clean state 完成 README 启用、确认、移除走查；之后才可推送并验证 GitHub 三系统与普通 Codex Cloud，再请求该 SHA 的具名人类授权，创建不可移动的轻量 v2.0 tag 和无资产 release，最终复验公开面、清理任务资源并重放本地验证。报告、计划、测试、提交、推送、托管绿灯或授权都不是收官；真实场域、跨宿主和长期效果继续作为后续证据。前置门失败退回最小受影响步骤；仅在人类判断、账户、外部信任、发布或不可逆边界暂停，接管后继续至有限收官。

complexityBudget.rule: Every retained mechanism must pay rent in observed help, risk reduction or recovery value after code, prompt, evidence, topology, cognition and lifecycle cost. A failed target blocks Q3 rather than inviting a larger verifier. Independent specification and standards review required fail-closed release-surface checks and cross-authority goal projection binding. A subtraction pass replaced scope-sensitive alias and data-flow inference with a direct active-Python historical-module token ban covering identifiers, static imports and literal or compile-time strings while allowing comments and adjacent identifiers. The code-and-test cap is therefore 130000 and must retain at least five percent headroom without deleting coverage or compressing readability.

processLossControl.carrierRule: Use current source-bound host signals when reliable; if capacity is unavailable, record unknown and transition conservatively. No universal turn count, context size, token percentage or summary ratio is product authority.
processLossControl.correctionRule: A repeated correction or failed same-purpose mechanism pauses further addition until the premise, interface and deletion option are reconsidered.
processLossControl.continuingCalibration: Post-release failures may update Golden Tasks, narrow a claim, simplify or retire a projection, or open one new bounded increment; release status does not freeze learning.
